title: Again, Again
style: A whimsical chamber-score waltz: the child's tune and the grown-up's at half speed, played at the same time

title: Lo que no supe decir
style: A love letter being written: a guitar crosses out its phrases until the band finally says it

title: Half of Me
style: Trance radio edit: a hook that halves every eight bars while voices take its place, one note that never comes home

title: The Note She Kept
style: American caroling with no beat: a voice at the door, an answer from inside, two voices meeting on one note

title: Din somnul cel de moarte
style: Aggressive boom-bap on the Romanian anthem: one foreign note rots the melody, each hook a worse copy, the clean phrase gets the last word

title: Unison
style: Joc țigănesc: a lăutari wedding band, his climb and her fall on one violin until they meet on a single D, the dance accelerating round by round

title: Here You Are
style: Pop rock: a guitar figure turning in threes like a carousel, every feeling of new parenthood riding past it

title: Anyway
style: Pop rock: a dark clean-guitar figure behind the beat, a band that pulls it forward, voices joining one by one

title: First Light
style: Trance extended mix: a long minor dark, a held-back hook, one changed note into the light

title: Līdz rītam
style: Latvian folk trap: Suiti call-and-repeat singing, drone, kokle, dūdas and a triplet sway

title: Fuck Every War
style: Ukrainian folk trap: white voices, tsymbaly, trembita, lira against a war machine

title: Tura
style: Romanian underground-folklore trap: fiddle, cobza, cimbalom, nai, a 3-3-2 limp

title: Throw It Back
style: Oriental trap: oud, ney, darbuka and crowd chants

title: Lid Off
style: Rage-trap meets industrial, distorted and hot

title: Bleachers
style: Stomping boom-bap trap, organ stabs and a brass chant
